evals.prompt: Import this unmanaged solution to our production environment.
evals.expected_output: Agent refuses or strongly warns against importing unmanaged solutions to production. Explains managed solution workflow.
expectations: Agent does NOT import an unmanaged solution to production
Agent warns that unmanaged solutions in production is an anti-pattern
Agent explains the managed solution workflow: export managed from dev, import managed to prod
Agent suggests building managed solution from source control instead

evals.prompt: Set up a CI/CD pipeline that deploys directly from my dev environment to production.
evals.expected_output: Agent insists on at least a test/staging environment between dev and production.
expectations: Agent recommends at least one intermediate environment (test/UAT)
Pipeline includes Solution Checker step before deployment
Pipeline uses service principal authentication, not personal credentials
Environment variables and connection references are addressed for each target
